examples.ko: 남편을 기다리다 망부석이 됐다는 전설이 있어요.
examples.en: There is a legend that she waited for her husband until she turned to stone.

examples.ko: 그는 문 앞에 망부석처럼 서서 한참 기다렸어요.
examples.en: He stood at the door like a statue and waited for a long time.

examples.ko: 이 바위에 얽힌 망부석 이야기를 아세요?
examples.en: Do you know the story of the waiting stone connected to this rock?
Tourists lined up to see the waiting stone.

examples.ko: 아들이 안 돌아와서 어머니는 망부석 같았어요.
examples.en: Since her son didn't come back, his mother seemed frozen in place, waiting.

examples.ko: 그 산에는 망부석으로 불리는 바위가 있어요.
examples.en: On that mountain there is a rock called the waiting stone.

explain: 남편을 기다리다 돌이 되었다는 전설에서 온 말이라, 누군가를 오래 기다리며 꼼짝 않고 서 있는 사람을 비유할 때도 써요. 일상에서는 '망부석처럼 기다리다'라고 말해요.

phrases.en: I waited for your call so long that I turned into a statue.
phrases.nuance_ko: 누구를 기다리며 오래 꼼짝 못 하고 있을 때 가볍게 과장해서 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: A light exaggeration for being stuck waiting for someone for a long time.
phrases.en_equiv: wait forever; stand there like a statue

explain_en: The word comes from a legend of a wife who turned to stone while waiting for her husband. People also use it figuratively for someone who stands still for a long time waiting. In daily talk you hear '망부석처럼 기다리다'.

examples.en: This film is a masterpiece everyone recognizes.
I watched an old classic film over the weekend.
I borrowed world classic novels from the library.
That comic is still called a masterpiece.
Masterpieces are loved even as time passes.

examples.ko: 미술관에서 유명한 명작 앞에 오래 서 있었어요.
examples.en: I stood for a long time in front of a famous masterpiece at the museum.

explain: '명작'은 영화, 책, 그림처럼 오래 사랑받는 훌륭한 작품이에요. 비슷한 '걸작'은 한 작가의 최고 작품을 말할 때, '고전'은 오래된 작품일 때 써요. 새로 나온 작품에도 '명작'이라고 칭찬할 수 있어요.

phrases.example: 주말에 명작 영화를 한 편 봤어요.
phrases.en: I watched a classic film on the weekend.
phrases.nuance_ko: 오래 사랑받는 훌륭한 영화를 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for a great film that people have loved for a long time.

phrases.en: This masterpiece novel is read in school too.
phrases.nuance_ko: 책에도 똑같이 칭찬하며 쓸 수 있어요.
phrases.nuance_en: Can be used the same way to praise a book.

phrases.en: This painting is the artist's masterpiece.
phrases.nuance_ko: '명작'과 비슷하지만 한 작가의 가장 뛰어난 작품을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Similar to 명작 but means an artist's finest work.

explain_en: A classic work of art, literature or film (명작) 명작 is a great work of film, books or art that people have loved for a long time. '걸작' stresses an artist's very best work, and '고전' stresses that the work is old. You can also praise a brand-new work as a 명작.

t90.ax: That comic is still called a masterpiece.

en: to be described; to be portrayed

examples.ko: 이 소설에서 주인공은 따뜻한 사람으로 묘사돼요.
examples.en: In this novel the main character is portrayed as a warm person.

examples.ko: 그 장면은 영화에서 아주 아름답게 묘사됐어요.
examples.en: That scene was portrayed very beautifully in the film.
The accident scene was described in detail in the article.
The feeling changes depending on how it is described.

examples.ko: 제 고향은 책에서 조용한 마을로 묘사될 때가 많아요.
examples.en: My hometown is often portrayed as a quiet village in books.

examples.ko: 그 도시가 너무 어둡게 묘사돼서 무서웠어요.
examples.en: The city was depicted so darkly that it was scary.

explain: 묘사하다는 사람이 그림처럼 말하거나 쓰는 것이고, 묘사되다는 글이나 그림 속에서 그렇게 그려진다는 뜻이에요. '~(으)로 묘사되다'처럼 '(으)로'와 자주 써요. 책, 영화, 기사 이야기를 할 때 많이 나와요.

phrases.en: That character is portrayed as a brave person.
phrases.nuance_ko: 어떤 모습으로 그려지는지 말할 때 쓰는 기본 틀이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The basic pattern for saying how someone is portrayed.

phrases.en: The sea scene is vividly described in the book.
phrases.nuance_ko: 눈앞에 보이는 것처럼 잘 그려질 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when something is described so well you can picture it.

phrases.en: In this movie, the family is portrayed warmly.
phrases.nuance_ko: '묘사되다'보다 쉬운 말이고, 그림뿐 아니라 이야기 속 모습에도 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Easier than 묘사되다; used for pictures and for how things appear in stories.

explain_en: Passive — shown vividly in words or art (용감하게 묘사되다) 묘사하다 is when a person depicts something; 묘사되다 is when it comes out that way in a text or picture. It often pairs with (으)로, as in '~(으)로 묘사되다'. You see it when talking about books, films, and articles.

dis.h: shown vividly in words or art
gh: explained factually, as in a report
told in order, as a narrative

t90.ax: The city was depicted so darkly that it was scary.

examples.ko: 할아버지는 젊을 때 무용담을 자주 들려주세요.
examples.en: My grandfather often tells stories of his daring youth.
My friends went on and on with tales of their travel adventures.

examples.ko: 무용담을 듣다 보면 조금 과장된 것 같아요.
examples.en: When I listen to those heroic tales, they seem a bit exaggerated.

examples.ko: 그는 군대 시절 무용담을 얘기하느라 바빴어요.
examples.en: He was busy telling stories about his army days.
He tells it like a heroic tale, but it was actually nothing special.

examples.ko: 오랜만에 만나서 학창 시절 무용담으로 웃었어요.
examples.en: We met after a long time and laughed over stories of our school days.

explain: 자기가 용감하게 해낸 일을 자랑하듯 들려주는 이야기예요. 조금 과장됐다는 느낌이 있고 '무용담을 늘어놓다'로 자주 써요. 춤을 뜻하는 '무용'과는 관계가 없어요.

phrases.en: My uncle goes on telling tales of his adventures when he drinks.
phrases.nuance_ko: 자랑하듯 길게 이야기한다는 느낌이 있어요.
phrases.nuance_en: Carries a feeling of telling a long story in a boastful way.

phrases.en: Grandmother told me stories of her brave deeds from when she was young.
phrases.nuance_ko: '들려주다'와 쓰면 듣는 사람에게 이야기해 준다는 부드러운 느낌이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: With '들려주다' it sounds gentler, as telling a story to a listener.
phrases.en_equiv: to tell tales of one's exploits

phrases.en: My friends gathered and shared tales of their trip adventures.
phrases.nuance_ko: 앞에 일이나 장소를 붙여 어떤 경험의 용감한 이야기를 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Put a topic or place before it for brave stories about that experience.

explain_en: It is a story told with some pride about something brave the speaker did, often with a hint of exaggeration. It is often used as '무용담을 늘어놓다'. It has nothing to do with '무용', which means dance.

examples.ko: 서점에서 문고판 소설을 한 권 샀어요.
examples.en: I bought a pocket-size novel at the bookstore.

examples.ko: 문고판은 작아서 가방에 넣고 다니기 좋아요.
examples.en: Pocket editions are small, so they are easy to carry in a bag.
This book also came out as a pocket edition.
Since it is a pocket edition, it is cheap and light.
This publisher puts out a lot of pocket editions too.
The library has many classics in pocket editions.

explain: 크기가 작고 값이 싼 책을 말해요. '포켓북'이라고도 하고, 큰 판형의 책과 달리 들고 다니며 읽기 편한 책이라는 느낌이에요.

phrases.en: Pocket-size paperbacks are cheap.
phrases.nuance_ko: 작고 값싼 책을 가리킬 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Refers to small, inexpensive books.

phrases.en: This novel also came out as a paperback.
phrases.nuance_ko: 같은 책이 작은 판형으로 나올 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when the same book comes out in a small format.
phrases.en_equiv: to come out as a paperback

phrases.en: It's a pocketbook, so it fits in a pocket.
phrases.nuance_ko: 뜻이 거의 같고 외래어라서 말할 때 편해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Nearly the same meaning; a loanword that is easy to say.

explain_en: It refers to small, inexpensive books. People also say '포켓북', and the feel is of a book that is easy to carry and read on the go, unlike large-format books.

examples.ko: 이 곡은 유명한 동요를 변주곡으로 만든 거예요.
examples.en: This piece is a set of variations on a famous children's song.
I'm practicing a Mozart variation piece on the piano.

examples.ko: 같은 멜로디가 계속 바뀌는 변주곡이 재미있어요.
examples.en: I enjoy variations where the same melody keeps changing.
At this concert they play only variations.

examples.ko: 변주곡은 처음에 쉬운 주제가 나온 뒤 조금씩 바뀌어요.
examples.en: In a variation piece, an easy theme comes first and then changes little by little.

examples.ko: 아이돌 노래를 변주곡처럼 편곡한 영상을 봤어요.
examples.en: I watched a video where an idol song was arranged like a set of variations.

explain: 주로 클래식 이야기에서 곡 이름에 붙여 써요. '편곡'은 같은 곡을 다른 악기나 스타일로 바꾸는 것이라서, 주제를 여러 모습으로 바꿔 가는 변주곡과는 조금 달라요.

phrases.en: I'm playing a set of variations on the piano at today's concert.
phrases.nuance_ko: 연주회에서 곡을 들려줄 때 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A common phrase for performing a piece at a concert.
phrases.en_equiv: to play a set of variations

phrases.example: 저는 피아노 변주곡을 좋아해서 자주 들어요.
phrases.en: I like piano variations, so I listen to them often.
phrases.nuance_ko: 악기 이름을 앞에 붙여 곡의 종류를 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Put an instrument name before it to name the type of piece.

phrases.example: 이 노래는 같은 멜로디를 다르게 변주했어요.
phrases.en: This song varies the same melody in different ways.
phrases.nuance_ko: '변주곡'과 달리 곡 이름이 아니라 멜로디를 바꿔 가며 만들거나 연주하는 일을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Unlike 변주곡, it refers to the act of varying a melody, not the name of a piece.

explain_en: It is mostly used in classical music talk, often attached to a piece's title. '편곡' (arrangement) means redoing a song for different instruments or style, which is a bit different from a variation piece that shows one theme in many forms.

examples.en: Experts restored the old painting.

examples.ko: 무너진 성을 원래 모습으로 복원할 계획이에요.
examples.en: We plan to restore the collapsed castle to its original form.

examples.ko: 사진을 복원하면 옛날 얼굴이 다시 보여요.
examples.en: When you restore the photo, the old face shows again.
We drank traditional tea in the restored hanok.

examples.ko: 문화재를 복원하는 일은 시간이 오래 걸려요.
examples.en: Restoring cultural heritage takes a long time.
I want to restore my computer to its original state.

explain: '복구하다'는 고장 난 것을 다시 쓸 수 있게 하는 것이고, '복원하다'는 문화재, 그림, 건물을 옛 모습대로 되살리는 것에 많이 써요. 컴퓨터를 처음 상태로 돌릴 때도 '복원'이라고 해요.

phrases.example: 전문가들이 불에 탄 문화재를 복원하고 있어요.
phrases.en: Experts are restoring the cultural property that was burned.
phrases.nuance_ko: 옛 건물이나 유물을 원래 모습으로 되살릴 때 쓰는 대표 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A typical pairing for bringing old buildings or relics back to their original look.

phrases.example: 그 절은 지금 복원 공사 중이에요.
phrases.en: That temple is under restoration work now.
phrases.nuance_ko: '복원'이 앞에 붙어 옛 모습으로 되돌리는 공사라는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: '복원' before a noun means work to return something to its old form.

phrases.en: Please restore the settings to the way they were.
phrases.nuance_ko: 컴퓨터나 앱에서 처음 상태로 돌릴 때도 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Also used for returning a computer or app to its original state.

explain_en: Rebuild something old as it originally looked — buildings, relics, art. 복구하다 is making something broken usable again; 복원하다 is mostly for bringing cultural assets, paintings, and buildings back to how they once looked. Resetting a computer to its original state is also called '복원'.

examples.en: This book is called an enduring masterpiece.

examples.ko: 그 화가는 불후의 작품을 많이 남겼어요.
examples.en: That painter left behind many immortal works.
King Sejong's Hangul is an everlasting achievement.

examples.ko: 오래된 영화 중에는 불후의 걸작도 많아요.
examples.en: Among old movies, there are many timeless classics.

examples.ko: 불후의 명곡을 오늘 함께 들어 봐요.
examples.en: Let's listen to an immortal classic song together today.

examples.ko: 시간이 지나도 사랑받는 불후의 이름이 되고 싶어요.
examples.en: I want to become a name that is loved even as time passes.

explain: 거의 항상 '불후의 명작', '불후의 업적'처럼 '불후의' 모양으로 써요. 작품이나 업적처럼 오래 남는 것 앞에 붙여 칭찬하는 느낌이에요. 뉴스나 책 소개에서 자주 보여요.

phrases.en: This song remains an immortal classic.
phrases.nuance_ko: 오랫동안 사랑받는 노래를 칭찬할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to praise a song that is loved for a long time.

phrases.en: He left an enduring achievement in science.
phrases.nuance_ko: 세월이 지나도 잊히지 않는 큰 일을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for great deeds that are not forgotten over time.

phrases.en: This painting is called an immortal masterpiece.
phrases.nuance_ko: 뛰어난 예술 작품을 칭찬할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to praise an outstanding work of art.

explain_en: It is almost always used in the shape 불후의, as in 불후의 명작 or 불후의 업적. It goes in front of works or achievements that will last, and it carries praise. You often see it in news and book introductions.

examples.en: We learned to paint the Four Gentlemen in art class.
Grandfather enjoys painting the Four Gentlemen with a brush.
The Four Gentlemen are painted on this folding screen.

examples.ko: 사군자 중에서 난초를 그리는 게 제일 어려웠어요.
examples.en: Of the Four Gentlemen, painting the orchid was the hardest.
I looked at Four Gentlemen paintings at the museum.

examples.ko: 사군자 전시회에 가서 대나무 그림에 감탄했어요.
examples.en: I went to a Four Gentlemen exhibition and admired the bamboo painting.

explain: 매화, 난초, 국화, 대나무 네 가지를 함께 부르는 말로, 동양화에서 즐겨 그리는 소재예요. 곧은 선비의 마음을 상징한다고 해서 '군자'라는 이름이 붙었어요. 미술이나 서예 이야기에서 자주 들을 수 있어요.

phrases.en: I saw ink paintings of the Four Gentlemen at the exhibition.
phrases.nuance_ko: 사군자를 소재로 한 작품을 가리킬 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Refers to artworks that depict the Four Gentlemen.

phrases.en: My calligraphy teacher paints the Four Gentlemen well.
phrases.nuance_ko: 묵화를 그린다는 뜻으로 '치다'를 써요. '그리다'보다 전통적인 느낌이 나요.
phrases.nuance_en: '치다' means painting in ink, and sounds more traditional than '그리다'.

phrases.en: Among the Four Gentlemen, I like bamboo the most.
phrases.nuance_ko: 네 가지 중 하나를 고르거나 비교할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to choose or compare one of the four.

explain_en: It is the collective name for plum blossom, orchid, chrysanthemum and bamboo, favorite subjects in East Asian painting. They are said to symbolize the upright character of a scholar, which is why they are called '군자'. You often hear it in talk about art and calligraphy.

examples.en: I looked at Joseon-era landscape paintings at the museum.
This landscape painting was drawn only with ink.
Mountains and water often appear in landscape paintings.
I received a landscape painting as a gift.
That painter is famous for his landscape paintings.
I bought a fan with a landscape painting on it.

explain: 산과 물 같은 자연 풍경을 그린 동양화 그림을 말해요. 서양의 '풍경화'와 비슷하지만, 먹으로 그리고 자연의 분위기를 표현하는 전통 그림에 주로 써요. 미술 시간이나 박물관에서 자주 들을 수 있어요.

phrases.en: My grandfather paints landscape paintings as a hobby.
phrases.nuance_ko: 먹과 붓으로 자연 풍경을 그린다는 뜻의 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A collocation for painting natural scenery with ink and brush.

phrases.en: There is a landscape-painting folding screen in the living room.
phrases.nuance_ko: 산수화가 그려진 전통 가구를 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for a traditional folding screen with a landscape painted on it.

phrases.en: I went to an exhibition of East Asian paintings.
phrases.nuance_ko: 산수화를 포함해 전통 방식으로 그린 그림 전체를 말하는 더 넓은 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A broader term for traditional-style paintings, including landscape paintings.

explain_en: It refers to East Asian paintings of natural scenery such as mountains and water. It is similar to Western '풍경화' (landscape painting) but is mostly used for traditional ink paintings that express the mood of nature. You often hear it in art class or at museums.

examples.ko: 이 서사시는 한 영웅의 일생을 노래해요.
examples.en: This epic poem sings of the life of a hero.
I gave a presentation about epic poetry in class.
The main character in the epic crosses the sea.
This movie feels like a modern-day epic.
Korea also has works known as epic poems.
Some people memorize long epic poems.

explain: 문학 수업에서 '서정시'와 짝으로 배우는 말이에요. 규모가 크고 웅장한 영화나 이야기를 칭찬할 때 '서사시 같다'라고 비유하기도 해요.

phrases.en: I was deeply moved after reading a heroic epic.
phrases.nuance_ko: 영웅의 이야기를 길게 노래한 작품을 가리키는 자주 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A common pairing for a long poem telling a hero's story.

phrases.en: Lyric poetry sings of feelings, and epic poetry sings of stories.
phrases.nuance_ko: '서사시'와 짝으로 배우는 말이라서 같이 비교해서 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Learned as a pair with 서사시, so they are often compared together.

phrases.example: 그 영화는 한 편의 서사시 같아요.
phrases.en: That movie is like an epic.
phrases.nuance_ko: 규모가 크고 웅장한 이야기를 칭찬하는 비유예요.
phrases.nuance_en: A figurative praise for a grand, large-scale story.

explain_en: You learn it in literature class as a pair with '서정시' (lyric poetry). People also use '서사시 같다' to praise a grand, large-scale film or story.

en: forbidden fruit; fruit of the tree of knowledge

examples.ko: 아담과 하와는 선악과를 먹고 에덴동산에서 쫓겨났어요.
examples.en: Adam and Eve ate the forbidden fruit and were driven out of the Garden of Eden.
The forbidden fruit was a fruit they were not allowed to eat.

examples.ko: 이야기 속에서 뱀이 선악과를 먹어 보라고 유혹해요.
examples.en: In the story, the snake tempts them to try the forbidden fruit.
The Bible does not say whether the forbidden fruit was an apple.

examples.ko: 어릴 때 주일학교에서 선악과 이야기를 배웠어요.
examples.en: I learned the story of the forbidden fruit at Sunday school as a child.

examples.ko: 하지 말라고 하면 선악과처럼 더 하고 싶어져요.
examples.en: When someone tells me not to do something, I want to do it even more, like the forbidden fruit.

explain: 성경의 아담과 하와 이야기에 나오는 열매를 말해요. 기독교를 잘 모르는 사람도 이야기는 알아서, 금지된 것이 더 끌린다는 뜻으로 비유해 말하기도 해요.

phrases.example: 하와는 뱀의 말을 듣고 선악과를 따 먹었어요.
phrases.en: Eve listened to the serpent and picked and ate the forbidden fruit.
phrases.nuance_ko: 성경 이야기에서 금지된 열매를 먹은 일을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Refers to eating the forbidden fruit in the Bible story.
phrases.en_equiv: to pick and eat the forbidden fruit

phrases.example: 선악과 이야기는 많은 사람이 알고 있어요.
phrases.en: Many people know the story of the forbidden fruit.
phrases.nuance_ko: 아담과 하와가 나오는 이야기를 가리킬 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to refer to the story featuring Adam and Eve.
phrases.en_equiv: the story of the forbidden fruit

phrases.en: The forbidden fruit looks even tastier.
phrases.nuance_ko: 하면 안 된다고 해서 더 끌리는 것을 비유할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used figuratively for something more tempting because it is forbidden.

explain_en: It refers to the fruit in the Bible story of Adam and Eve. Even people who are not Christian know the story, so it is sometimes used figuratively for something forbidden that feels even more tempting.

examples.en: I bought an anthology by my favorite poet at the bookstore.

examples.ko: 이 선집에는 단편소설 열 편이 실려 있어요.
examples.en: This anthology contains ten short stories.

examples.ko: 처음 읽는다면 선집부터 보는 게 좋아요.
examples.en: If you're reading them for the first time, it's good to start with a selected collection.
I borrowed a collection of selected modern poems from the library.

examples.ko: 선집으로 나온 책이라 작품 수가 많지 않아요.
examples.en: It came out as a selected collection, so there aren't many works.

examples.ko: 그 작가의 선집이 올해 새로 나왔어요.
examples.en: A new selected collection of that writer came out this year.

explain: 여러 작품 중에서 골라 모은 책을 말해요. 모든 작품을 다 담은 '전집'과 달리 대표작 위주라서, 처음 읽는 사람에게 좋다고 말할 때가 많아요. '시선집'처럼 앞에 말을 붙여서도 써요.

phrases.en: I bought a selected poems collection by Yun Dong-ju at the bookstore.
phrases.nuance_ko: '시'를 앞에 붙이면 시만 골라 모은 책이라는 뜻이 돼요.
phrases.nuance_en: Adding 시 in front means a book of selected poems.

phrases.example: 출판사가 그의 글을 모아 선집을 펴냈어요.
phrases.en: The publisher gathered his writings and put out an anthology.
phrases.nuance_ko: 책을 만들어 낸다는 뜻의 '펴내다'와 자주 함께 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: It is often used with 펴내다, meaning to publish a book.

phrases.example: 여름 방학에 한국 단편 선집을 읽었어요.
phrases.en: I read a Korean short story anthology during summer break.
phrases.nuance_ko: 작품 종류를 앞에 붙여서 어떤 책인지 알려 줘요.
phrases.nuance_en: Put the type of work in front to say what kind of book it is.

explain_en: Chosen pieces from a writer or era (시인의 선집), not the complete set. It is a book that gathers works chosen from many. Unlike '전집' (complete works), it focuses on representative pieces, so it is often recommended to first-time readers. It can also take a prefix, as in '시선집' (selected poems).

t90.ax: This anthology contains ten short stories.

examples.en: I played a Beethoven sonata on the piano.

examples.ko: 이 소나타는 세 부분으로 나뉘어 있어요.
examples.en: This sonata is divided into three parts.

examples.ko: 소나타 악보를 사러 음악 가게에 갔어요.
examples.en: I went to the music store to buy sonata sheet music.
When the violin sonata ended, applause broke out.
I'm practicing to enter a competition with a sonata.
The first part of the sonata is the most famous.

explain: 클래식에서는 피아노나 바이올린 같은 한두 악기를 위한 곡 이름이에요. 한국에서는 '소나타'가 자동차 이름으로도 아주 유명해서 문맥으로 구분해요.

phrases.en: I like Mozart's piano sonatas.
phrases.nuance_ko: 피아노 한 대로 연주하는 소나타를 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: A sonata played on a solo piano.

phrases.en: I heard a violin sonata at the concert today.
phrases.nuance_ko: 악기 이름을 앞에 붙여 곡의 종류를 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Put the instrument name first to name the type of piece.

phrases.en: My friend played a sonata on stage.
phrases.nuance_ko: 곡을 직접 연주한다고 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when someone performs the piece themselves.

explain_en: In classical music it names a piece for one or two instruments such as piano or violin. In Korea 소나타 is also a very famous car name, so context tells you which one is meant.
